facts.fact: xAI released Grok Build to all X Premium+ and SuperGrok users on May 25, 2026.
facts.quote: On May 25, 2026, xAI released Grok Build to all X Premium+ and SuperGrok users.

facts.fact: Grok Build was initially limited to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers on May 14 before the target was expanded on May 25.
facts.quote: Since it was limited to SuperGrok Heavy on May 14 and the target was expanded on May 25

facts.fact: Only X Premium+ or SuperGrok subscribers can use Grok Build; standard X Premium is not eligible.
facts.quote: You can only use Grok Build if you are a subscriber to X Premium+ or SuperGrok; standard X Premium is not eligible.

facts.fact: Based on US standards as of May 2026, X Premium+ costs $40 per month.
facts.quote: As of May 2026, based on US standards, X Premium+ is $40

facts.fact: Based on US standards as of May 2026, SuperGrok costs $30 per month.
facts.quote: SuperGrok is $30, and SuperGrok Heavy is $300

facts.fact: Based on US standards as of May 2026, SuperGrok Heavy costs $300 per month.
facts.quote: SuperGrok Heavy is $300, with reports that X Premium+ in Japan is approximately 6,080 yen/month

facts.fact: The page reports that X Premium+ in Japan costs approximately 6,080 yen per month, and notes that prices vary by region and time.
facts.quote: reports that X Premium+ in Japan is approximately 6,080 yen/month. However, this varies by region and time.

facts.fact: The '$99 unlimited SuperGrok' claim is a confusion with a 6-month limited promo for SuperGrok Heavy, not the standard SuperGrok price.
facts.quote: The pitfall is the view that 'SuperGrok is unlimited for $99.'

facts.fact: On May 26, the Grok Build beta quota was reset after feedback that limits were being hit too quickly.
facts.quote: On May 26, the beta quota was reset following feedback that the limits were being hit too quickly.

facts.fact: The usage allowance for consumer plans is not officially disclosed.
facts.quote: The usage allowance for consumer plans—that is, how many times you can use it per day—is not officially disclosed

facts.fact: Grok Build's default model is grok-build (API name grok-build-0.1), specialized for coding.
facts.quote: The default model is grok-build, or grok-build-0.1 by API name.

facts.fact: Grok Build's context window is 256K tokens.
facts.quote: it has been confirmed that the context window is 256K tokens

facts.fact: Grok Build's API pricing is $1.00 per 1 million input tokens and $2.00 per 1 million output tokens.
facts.quote: API unit prices of $1.00 for input and $2.00 for output per 1 million tokens.

facts.fact: A reported SWE-bench Verified score of 70.8% for Grok Build has appeared, but the page says the official source could not be verified.
facts.quote: While the figure 'SWE-bench Verified 70.8%' has appeared, it is safer to treat this as a reported value

facts.fact: Grok Build is a native binary that does not require Node.js and installs in one line on macOS and Linux.
facts.quote: It is a native binary, so Node.js is not required, and it installs in one line on macOS and Linux

facts.fact: The Grok Build CLI version the author verified on their machine was grok 0.2.3.
facts.quote: The CLI I verified on my machine was `grok 0.2.3`

facts.fact: The author states that the Grok Build context window for the grok-build model is 256K.
facts.quote: the 256K grok-build, and `--best-of-n`

facts.fact: In headless environments, Grok Build runs with an XAI_API_KEY, and processing is governed by API-side limits rather than the subscription allowance.
facts.quote: pass `XAI_API_KEY` to run it. The input is the API key and prompt

facts.fact: To exit a Grok Build session, the user presses Ctrl+C twice, and resumes with `grok resume`.
facts.quote: To exit a session, press `Ctrl+C` twice, and to resume, run `grok resume`.

facts.fact: The author describes Grok Build as an early beta with undisclosed usage limits for consumer plans.
facts.quote: since it's an early beta with undisclosed usage limits for consumer plans

facts.fact: The author says Grok Build is worth trying for users who already have X Premium+ or SuperGrok subscriptions, while advising waiting before subscribing just for Grok Build.
facts.quote: if you already have X Premium+ or SuperGrok, it's worth a try, but if you're considering a new subscription just for Grok Build, it's safer to wait and see

facts.fact: The author recommends checking existing `.claude/` assets with `grok inspect` before using Grok Build for heavier work, including API pay-as-you-go costs.
facts.quote: check your existing `.claude/` assets with `grok inspect`, try small fixes in the TUI
